create.name: Leslie Booker
create.bio:
Leslie Booker, known to most students simply as Booker, is a Buddhist meditation teacher and writer whose teaching joins the dharma with embodiment and collective liberation. She began as a yoga teacher in 2007, then trained at Spirit Rock in mindful yoga and meditation, went on to its Community Dharma Leaders programme under the guidance of Gina Sharpe, and completed its four-year retreat teacher training in 2020. For more than ten years she also directed teacher trainings for the Lineage Project, bringing yoga and mindfulness to young people in the justice system in New York.

Today she lives in Philadelphia and is co-guiding teacher of New York Insight Meditation Center. She leads silent insight retreats and daylongs at centres around the United States, both on site and online, and runs small three-month mentoring groups in which three people at a time study core Buddhist teachings and build a steady practice together. She lectures at universities, has written for Lion's Roar, Tricycle, Yoga Journal and Ten Percent Happier, and co-founded the Yoga Service Council. Her teaching style is warm and direct, with a strong emphasis on community and belonging.

courses.title: 3 Month Mentoring Program
courses.description: Small mentoring groups of three people who meet with Booker over twelve weeks to study core Buddhist teachings and carry practice into daily life. The programme includes group sessions, two one-to-one sessions and half-day opening and closing retreats; new groups are gathered through a waiting list.

free_resources.title: How to Practice Walking Meditation
free_resources.description: Booker's step-by-step guide to walking meditation, published by Lion's Roar and linked from her teachings page.

free_resources.title: A 20-Minute Practice to Hold the Emotional Body
free_resources.description: A guided practice of about twenty minutes, published by Mindful, for noticing feelings in the body with patience and care.
